01 — ABOUT MEPROFILE / 2026

Engineering systems.
Learning by building.

I’m an aspiring Robotics and Automation engineer at L. D. College of Engineering, Ahmedabad. I’m interested in self-learning and building things across AI, digital logic, system design, neural networks, and robotics.

My work so far includes an autonomous waste-sorting concept, a posture-recognition web app, an AI-powered smart farm assistant robot, and computer-vision experiments. I enjoy moving from an idea to a working prototype, testing what works, and improving what doesn’t.

Things I’ve worked on.

PROJECT 01 · AGRITECHAI / ROBOTICS

AI-Powered Smart Farm Assistant

A smart-farming concept designed to support farmers with field observations and practical guidance. The dashboard visualizes crop health and environmental conditions; the wider idea is to help improve crop efficiency through a farm-deployed robot.

Smart AgricultureEnvironmental DataRobotics
PROJECT 02 · ROBOTICSPROTOTYPE

Autonomous Rover Prototype

A student-built mobile robot prototype integrating a camera and hardware components. It represents hands-on exploration of mobile robotics, sensing, embedded systems, and the challenges of turning a design into a physical machine.

Embedded SystemsSensorsRobotics
PROJECT 03 · COMPUTER VISIONDETECTION

Fruit Detection with Computer Vision

An object-detection experiment that identifies fruit in orchard imagery and displays model confidence scores. This direction can support crop monitoring, yield estimation, and future agricultural automation.

Computer VisionDeep LearningObject Detection

PROJECT 04 · LANGUAGE MODELBUILT FROM SCRATCH

Little Shakespeare

I built Little Shakespeare, a 35-million-parameter language model from scratch, single-handedly, trained on the literary works of William Shakespeare. The project explores language modeling, training workflows, and generating text in a Shakespeare-inspired style.

Language ModelingDeep LearningPython
